name: Stone Circle
summary: The Stone Circle is a serpent-marked stone kept in Marvon Rivetseeker’s workshop in Ratchet. It recalls a circular chamber in the Sunken Temple.

sections.title: A Serpent Mark
sections.body: Marvon Rivetseeker keeps the Stone Circle in his Ratchet workshop, where he asks you to retrieve it. He remembers finding a matching serpent symbol after escaping the Sunken Temple. The stone may help him recall more of what he saw there.

faq.answer: The Stone Circle is a round stone marked with a serpent symbol, kept in Marvon Rivetseeker’s workshop in Ratchet.
Marvon Rivetseeker has the Stone Circle in his workshop in Ratchet.
Marvon Rivetseeker asks you to retrieve the Stone Circle from his workshop in Ratchet.

faq.q: What does the serpent mark mean?
faq.answer: The serpent symbol matches the statues Marvon remembers in a circular chamber of the Sunken Temple.
Marvon hopes the stone will help him remember his escape from the Sunken Temple and tell him more about the place.
